searchText: You are already breaking user assumptions with eip8037 new state pricing. Overcharging is already broken. And I don't follow the notion that builders will need to do more, or do something for free. Proposal is for builders to do exactly what is needed and all that work is covered by gas. I am just applying what we do inside the frame to pre execution (eip7703 list and target loading). And unifying those two.
